caption: The same cell drawn at three steps: x(t) and h(t−1) are mixed into h(t), which feeds the output y(t) and the next copy of the cell. The dashed arrow reuses the same recurrent matrix, so unfolding adds no new parameters.

spec.title: Unfolded RNN
spec.aria: The same hidden cell is reused at three time steps: x(t) and h(t-1) form h(t), which gives y(t) and passes to h(t+1).
